title: VerifyWhitepaperResponse
description: Response payload for the verify_whitepaper offering. Derived from TokenomicsAuditReport (extends LegitimacyScanReport) in @grey/schemas/src/index.ts.

claimScores.description: Per-claim aggregate score, real range 0–1. Always populated for evaluated claims (no `null` sentinel — claim IDs without an entry indicate the claim was not in the input set, not 'unscored').
